notes.title: Exclusive First Look: 'Please, Watch The Artwork' Live at Tiny Teams
notes.notes:
[p][b]Dear lovers of art-touching and/or -watching,[/b][/p][p][/p][p]I have some news for you![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Spin-off[/b][/h3][p]As some of you might know, before continuing my journey on [b][i]'Please, Touch The Artwork 3'[/i][/b] I am first exploring a spin-off game [b][i]'Please, Watch The Artwork'[/i][/b], a casual psychological observation game where you'll have to spot differences in paintings, as a night-watch at The Museum of Animated Modern Art (MaMA).[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Edward Hopper[/b] [/h3][p]The game uses paintings of American realist painter Edward Hopper
There are no jump scares or monsters, but there are sad clowns and the game might make you a bit paranoid at times.[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3542500/Please_Watch_The_Artwork/"]However, I'm 100% sure a lot of you will like it!!![/url][/p][p][/p][p]And there will be a [b]cozy mode[/b] for those who don't like pressure.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3542500/Please_Watch_The_Artwork/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3][b]Premiere Spotlight[/b][/h3][p]I'm happy to announce the first gameplay will be [b]live-streamed[/b] by the people at The Yogscast during their Tiny Teams event.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]When?[/b][/h3][p]Thursday August 14th at 6AM Pacific Time, 9AM Eastern Time and 2PM British Time (sorry, it's a British event :))[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Where:[/b][/h3][p]Steam:  [/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TinyTeams2025"]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TinyTeams2025[/url][/p][p]Twitch: [/p][p] [dynamiclink href="https://www.twitch.tv/yogscast"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Youtube:
[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@yogscast"][/dynamiclink] [/p][p][/p][p]Curious to know what you think![/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p]Thomas[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: [New Game] Night Watch at the Museum, but the Paintings Are Alive
notes.notes: [p]Hey everybody![/p][p][/p][p]I'm happy to introduce my new art-inspired spin-off game: [i][b]Please, Watch The Artwork[/b][/i][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3542500/Please_Watch_The_Artwork/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3][i]Pitch:[/i][/h3][p][i]Night surveillance at the museum but the paintings are alive. Watch, listen and report all changes. A lonely clown roams the canvases. Eerie. Weird. Melancholic. Relaxing? No jump scares or monsters, but the game can feel oppressive at times. And there's a cozy mode![/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731779/82140ac941779d8b11f60cdb384e8b8fafae113c.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Day Of The Devs[/h3][p]It was announced yesterday during the Summer Game Fest : Day Of The Devs livestream, together with the launch of the Steam-page.[/p][p][/p][p]You can all enjoy my ASMR middle-of-the-night recorded introduction here 😊 :[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oEm6wAdqfEY&t=3411"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Thanks to the lovely people at Iam8bit and Double Fine Productions who are doing this as an all-volunteer non-profit to celebrate the magic of videogames![/p][p][/p][h3]What about Please, Touch The Artwork 3?[/h3][p][i]'Please, Watch The Artwork'[/i] is a spin-off from the [i]'Please, Touch The Artwork'[/i]-series, but [b]NO WORRIES: 'Please, Touch The Artwork 3' is also in the making! [/b]I just wanted to do something different in between projects.[/p][p][/p][p]Have a nice weekend![/p][p]Thomas[/p]

notes.title: New Game Announcement Tonight during Summer Game Fest livestream
notes.notes:
Hey touchers-of-art!

Today/tonight I'm revealing my new art-based game [i]'Please, Watch The Artwork'[/i] during the Day Of The Devs stream, part of Summer Game Fest.

[i]'Please, Watch The Artwork'[/i] is a spin-off from the [i]'Please, Touch The Artwork'[/i]-series, but [b]NO WORRIES: 'Please, Touch The Artwork 3' is also in the making![/b]

I will give a small introduction on why/how I made the game and you'll get to see the world premier of the trailer!

Tune in Friday June 6th (today) at 4pm Pacific Time, 7pm Eastern Time, 1am CEST, right after the official livestream of Summer Game Fest.

Link to the livestream:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-Hr6Q2hln_M&ab_channel=thegameawards

Link to the steam-page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3542500/Please_Watch_The_Artwork/

I'm excited, hope you are too!
Thomas

notes.title: Classic videogame designs meet modern art in Please, Touch the Artwork
notes.notes: The appeal of Thomas Waterzooi's debut game Please, Touch the Artwork is more than just its white-walled art gallery set dressing. It's one part psychogeography and one part "zen" art puzzle collection, but also a full-fledged descendant of classic videogames like Snake and Pong... Read more.

notes.title: Please, Touch The Artwork is out now ! 🟦🟨🟥
notes.notes:
Hey art-touchers!

It's done. You can finally touch the untouchable.

[h2][h1]Please, Touch The Artwork is out now on Steam![/h1][/h2]

[previewyoutube=wFymuyX35WE;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]What happens if you DO touch the artwork? [/i]

In this relaxing narrative zen puzzler you'll unravel the secret world behind some of the most iconic abstract paintings made in the 20th century. There are 3 games in this game, each based on a different artwork. Each game has it's own original puzzly-mechanics and a story driving the gameplay.

After 4 years of iteration after iteration I'm so excited to finally share this cozy game with you!
I took the time to carefully craft every experience and make it the most relaxing experience possible.
I hope you enjoy it as much as I enjoyed making it.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/braGIZRBn3cPlJwRbI/giphy.gif[/img]

I'm just a solo-developer working on this project so I would be super grateful if you could help me with:
[list]
[*] Spreading the word about the game at your next family event ;)
[*] Leaving a review on Steam
[*] Sharing on social media
[/list]

And of course, you can join my small community on [url=https://discord.com/invite/vtjnWtZ6UA]Discord[/url], to talk about art, games as an art-form or anything else.


Happy touching and thanks again!

Cheers,

Thomas
